verdict.rationale: Persona's API reference documents pre-creating inquiries via the API and polling for inquiry statuses or fetching verification details, which covers creating a session, getting its status and retrieving results. Nothing in the evidence documents retrieving captured media (ID images, selfies) or cancelling or redacting an inquiry through the API. Missing for 10: documented captured-media retrieval endpoints, cancel/expire endpoint, redaction endpoint, per-step endpoint-level docs and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the whole verification lifecycle is drivable through the API — create a session, get its status, retrieve results and captured media, and cancel or redact it — with every step documented

citations.quote: Use the API to pre-create inquiries before directing users through the inquiry flow for information collection and verification.
Poll the API for the latest inquiry statuses or fetch specific verification details without disrupting your primary integration.
Transactions API | backend-only verification APIs, no Persona UI | Fully custom UI or backend-only verification flows
